name: io.github.bibinprathap/veritasgraph
description: Zero-trust, air-gapped Enterprise GraphRAG MCP server with offline, citation-grounded answers.

environmentVariables.name: VERITASGRAPH_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Default local Ollama model for ingest/query (e.g. qwen3:latest).

environmentVariables.name: VERITASGRAPH_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool tier exposed to the client: read, write or admin.

environmentVariables.name: STUDIO_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Data directory; the SQLite graph store lives here unless VERITASGRAPH_DB is set.

environmentVariables.name: VERITASGRAPH_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite graph store shared with Studio and the CLI.

environmentVariables.name: VERITASGRAPH_PII_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: PII handling on ingest: off, tag, redact_before_extract or reject.
